goals: Make Nemo's intended single-flower bonemeal behavior deterministic when BedrockIfy and Nemo's Blooming Blossom both contribute the same FlowerBlock methods.
Preserve BedrockIfy's fertilizable-block configuration and separate sugar-cane behavior while leaving Nemo's independent wither-rose and grass behavior intact.
scope: Own exactly one common FlowerBlock mixin at priority 1100 and exactly the three audited BonemealableBlock methods: isValidBonemealTarget, isBonemealSuccess, and performBonemeal.
Retain Nemo's exact FlowerBlock method policy: target validity and success are unconditional, and the server pops one item matching the clicked flower without nearby propagation.
Require BedrockIfy 1.11.8+mc26.2 and Nemo's Blooming Blossom 26.2-1.3 through Fabric metadata without bundling either upstream mod.

exclusions: Any general BedrockIfy/Nemo integration layer, additional target, method, injector, reward algorithm, registry ownership, or upstream patch.
Disabling BedrockIfy's common.features.fertilizableBlocks setting or changing its separate SugarCaneBlockMixin behavior.
Changing Nemo's separate WitherRoseBlockMixin, either mod's GrassBlock behavior, tall flowers, or any vegetation outside FlowerBlock inheritance.

Third-party binary redistribution, originals changes, resource-pack work, STNC/QSN work, deployment, Test Slot or Test Instance Manager mutation, and access to either gameplay profile during this migration.
